currentQuestion.passage: With his diverse contributions to society as a military leader, teacher, and scholar, you might expect Kahneman to think his life was extremely meaningful, right? Wrong. Kahneman didn’t characterize his life as meaningful. In a 2018 interview, he said, “I recall a conversation with Martin Seligman, the founder of positive psychology, in which he tried to convince me I had a meaningful life.
options: That Kahneman had never contributed to society.
That he would describe his own life as extremely meaningful because of his contributions.
That Seligman had ever discussed meaning with him.
optionsZh: 贡献多，所以本人会称人生极有意义。
analyses: B you might expect 后的自我评价被否定，不能用外部荣誉代替本人体验。
D 当前引语明确回忆了与Seligman的谈话，不能否认讨论曾发生。

evidence.quote: With his diverse contributions to society as a military leader, teacher, and scholar, you might expect Kahneman to think his life was extremely meaningful, right? Wrong.

vocabulary.context: 本人用何种词描述人生，不等于客观判定人生无价值
vocabulary.example: She did not characterize the period as wholly happy.

currentQuestion.translation: 他作为军队领导者、教师、学者对社会贡献多样，你也许以为他会觉得人生极有意义吧？错了。他并不把人生描述为有意义。在2018年一次访谈中，他说自己记得与积极心理学创始人 Martin Seligman 的一次谈话，对方试图说服他，自己过了有意义的人生。
currentQuestion.editorialStatus: 完整PDF122–126原页视觉核对与跨页拼接。Nietzsche病痛回忆为个人归因且保留potential，非医疗试验；Kahneman论文4851为书载2022单年引用非今日累计，SS遭遇为其回忆不臆测照片身份或士兵内心、不美化纳粹迫害。严格区分本人interesting与作者psychologically rich；有意义/幸福非全称。Sandy触电按幸存者叙事译触电不误作死亡；37天住院/36年独立/500美元用途分开。Katrina迁移及2006返回与2018回顾分开，bomb/veil是比喻；幸存者纽带反思与灾难伤害并存，不作人人净获益保证。保留引语跨单元和原句指纹，不宣称逐句直接证据全覆盖。
